project_meta.description: Personal productivity tool to automatically generate a tailored CV and cover letter based on a job offer.

design_strategy.archetype: Archetype 3 Variant (Pastel & Soft mixed with High-Contrast Neo-Brutalist)
design_strategy.vibe: Optimistic, structured, premium SaaS, high-energy. Rejects boring corporate gray.
core_principles: No generic UI: Use sharp high-contrast borders with soft pastel fill colors.
Step-by-step clarity: Wizard flow must feel like a directed story, not a tax form.
Dashboard density: Information must be scannable, bento-grid style, maximizing space.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none text-zinc-900
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-zinc-900

surface_styles.card_neo_brutalist: bg-white border-2 border-zinc-900 shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(24,24,27,1)] rounded-lg transition-transform hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[6px_6px_0px_0px_rgba(24,24,27,1)]
surface_styles.input_field: bg-zinc-50 border-2 border-zinc-900 rounded-md px-4 py-3 text-zinc-900 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FF3E1A] focus:border-transparent transition-all
surface_styles.glass_header: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b-2 border-zinc-900 sticky top-0 z-50

buttons.primary: inline-flex items-center justify-center px-8 py-4 bg-[#FF3E1A] text-white font-bold text-lg border-2 border-zinc-900 rounded-md shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(24,24,27,1)] hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[6px_6px_0px_0px_rgba(24,24,27,1)] transition-all
buttons.secondary: inline-flex items-center justify-center px-6 py-3 bg-white text-zinc-900 font-bold border-2 border-zinc-900 rounded-md shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(24,24,27,1)] hover:bg-zinc-50 transition-all
buttons.ghost: inline-flex items-center justify-center px-4 py-2 text-zinc-600 font-semibold hover:text-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-100 rounded-md transition-all

wizard_flow.sidebar_steps: flex flex-col gap-4 border-r-2 border-zinc-900 p-8 bg-zinc-50 min-h-screen
wizard_flow.step_active: flex items-center gap-3 text-zinc-900 font-bold bg-white border-2 border-zinc-900 p-4 rounded-md shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(24,24,27,1)]
wizard_flow.step_inactive: flex items-center gap-3 text-zinc-400 font-medium p-4 hover:text-zinc-600 transition-colors

cv_templates.corporate_modern: bg-white border border-zinc-200 p-8 max-w-[210mm] min-h-[297mm] shadow-lg font-sans text-sm
cv_templates.startup_tech: bg-zinc-50 border-l-8 border-[#FF3E1A] p-8 max-w-[210mm] min-h-[297mm] shadow-lg font-sans text-sm

tags.keyword_match: inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1 bg-[#E8F5E9] text-zinc-900 font-bold text-xs border border-zinc-900 rounded-full
tags.keyword_missing: inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1 bg-[#F3E8FF] text-zinc-900 font-bold text-xs border border-zinc-900 rounded-full

images.usage: Use as a muted, low-opacity background for the welcome/auth screen or empty state.

icons.rules: Use stroke-width='2' or '2.5'. Must match the brutalist solid feel.

testing_attributes.rules: All interactive elements must include data-testid. Kebab-case, role-based.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the UI uses French text entirely (e.g., 'Importer votre CV', 'Générer le document').
The 4-step wizard should be heavily visual, breaking the steps into distinct, animated states.
For the file upload, implement a drag-and-drop zone using the neo-brutalist card style.
The dashboard layout displaying matches and history must utilize a tight 'Control Room' bento grid to show data efficiently.
Apply `Cabinet Grotesk` for all main headings (H1-H3) and `Outfit` for body text.
Do not use generic Shadcn components out of the box; they must be wrapped or restyled using the defined `surface_styles` with 2px borders and solid drop shadows.
